name: Fifteen Sermons Preached before the University of Oxford
name_pt: Quinze Sermões Pregados perante a Universidade de Oxford
desc: Newman's fifteen University Sermons of 1826 to 1843, preached before the University of Oxford: the philosophical temper first enjoined by the Gospel, the usurpations of reason, faith and reason as habits of mind, implicit and explicit reason, and the final sermon, The Theory of Developments in Religious Doctrine, which was the seed of his Essay on Development.
desc_pt: Os quinze Sermões Universitários de Newman, de 1826 a 1843, pregados perante a Universidade de Oxford: o temperamento filosófico primeiro exigido pelo Evangelho, as usurpações da razão, a fé e a razão como hábitos da mente, a razão implícita e explícita e o último sermão, A Teoria dos Desenvolvimentos na Doutrina Religiosa, semente do seu Ensaio sobre o Desenvolvimento.
editor: John Henry Newman (Longmans, uniform edition; Newman Reader)
edition: Fifteen Sermons preached before the University of Oxford (London: Rivingtons, 1843; Longmans, 3rd edition 1872), as transcribed by the Newman Reader.
note: Anglican-period work, reissued by Newman as a Catholic in the uniform edition.
